source.snapshot: working-tree contents; base commit alone does not identify this source

imagemagick: Version: ImageMagick 7.1.2-27 Q16-HDRI x86_64 e4c2b403b:20260705 https://imagemagick.org
timing_boundary: Core transform including wrapper, IPC, sandbox child, priority10 and encoder. Excludes Rails boot, source quality probe, evidence decoding, and FileHelper optimizer.
quality_policy: Explicit caller quality first; otherwise AVIF50; JPEG/WebP use source JPEG estimated Q or lossless WebP100, then JPEG92/WebP75. Probe frame0 before timing. Original ImageMagick instructions retain recorded quality options.

limitations: Crop historical output records include FileHelper optimization; new timed ImageMagick operations replay raw instruction arrays only.
Additional natural-photo/avatar/orientation/enlargement cases reuse recorded instruction templates and existing inputs, but have no historical output baseline.
No source ICC colorimetric accuracy conclusion: deployed ImageMagick may lack LCMS.

Visible pixel differences use ImageMagick-decoded PNGs converted to8-bit sRGB; original encoding/depth/profile metadata is recorded separately. Hidden RGB under transparent pixels is excluded from visible differences.
Post-optimizer and complete caller evidence must be measured separately.
